question.wording: Was this Form 1099-QA distribution used entirely for qualified disability expenses, or rolled over to another ABLE account within 60 days?

options.label: Yes — all of it; the earnings in box 2 are not income
No — some of it was not; the taxable part is figured by the preparer

citation.wording: Generally, amounts distributed that are used to pay for qualified disability expenses, or rolled over to another ABLE account within 60 days, are not included in income.
